# @tansy/request-logs

A log of every API request for tansy: kept in the database and shown on the dashboard, sent to S3 or any storage, an HTTP log drain, or the console, or all of them.

```bash
npm install @tansy/request-logs
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the request-logs plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/request-logs.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
